config SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE
	bool "Validate sys_heap integrity"
	help
	  Include internal validation code for sys_heap implementation.
	  Generates full-heap integrity check functions that can be called
	  from application code and unit tests.

config SYS_HEAP_STRESS
	bool "Include sys_heap stress test utility"
	help
	  Includes a stress test structural template referenced by the
	  sys_heap unit test infrastructure.

config SYS_HEAP_INFO
	bool "Include system heap information utility"
	help
	  Enable the compilation of Functions Used to output the embedded
	  information in the heap such as used and free memory.

config SYS_HEAP_ALLOC_LOOPS
	int "Number of tries in inner allocation loop"
	default 3
	help
	  Looking for a good chunk fit involves walking a singly linked
	  list of free chunks with sizes shown to be "at least as big as"
	  or "guaranteed big enough" for the requested size.  Set a maximum
	  of iterations after which we simply choose the smallest found so
	  far in the first list, or fallback to the first block in the
	  second list, in order to preserve fast allocation latencies.

config SYS_HEAP_RUNTIME_STATS
	bool "System heap runtime statistics"
	help
	  Enable collection of runtime statistics for each created sys_heap
	  such as currently allocated memory and maximum allocated memory.

config SYS_HEAP_LISTENER
	bool "System heap event listener"
	help
	  Enable registering listeners for heap events, such as memory
	  allocation and de-allocation, and heap resize.

choice SYS_HEAP_CHUNK_SIZE_TYPE
	prompt "System heap chunk size selection"
	default SYS_HEAP_AUTO
	help
	  Specify whether the heap library tries to use 16-bit chunk indices
	  for smaller heaps to reduce metadata overhead, or only supports
	  up to 32-bit chunk indices.

config SYS_HEAP_SMALL_ONLY
	bool "Support only small heaps"
	help
	  Optimize sys_heap implementation by assuming all heaps fit within
	  the small-heap threshold (<= 256 kilobytes on 32-bit platforms,
	  <= 512 kilobytes on 64-bit platforms).

config SYS_HEAP_BIG_ONLY
	bool "Support only big heaps"
	help
	  Simplify sys_heap implementation by using 32-bit chunk descriptors
	  for all heaps regardless of size.

config SYS_HEAP_AUTO
	bool "Automatically select small/big heap functions at runtime"
	help
	  Dynamically branch to small-heap or big-heap code based on the
	  initialized size of each heap.

endchoice

menuconfig SYS_HEAP_KASAN
	bool "Kernel Address Sanitizer (KASAN) for sys_heap"
	depends on !SAN_ADDRESS
	help
	  Enable software-based Address Sanitizer tracking in sys_heap.
	  When enabled, redzones and shadow memory are maintained for
	  allocations to detect out-of-bounds accesses and use-after-free
	  bugs.

if SYS_HEAP_KASAN

config SYS_HEAP_KASAN_MALLOC
	bool "Hook standard malloc/free/calloc/realloc with KASAN checks"
	default y if COMMON_LIBC_MALLOC || MINIMAL_LIBC
	help
	  Wrap standard C library allocation functions with KASAN checks.

endif # SYS_HEAP_KASAN
